_doc: Shared corpus for scripts/lib/sql-split.ts and aidream db/sql_split.py (D351). Both must return `expect` exactly.

cases.name: adjacent literals across a newline (the 1160/1161 failure)
expect:
select 'a door a client may call '
       'ONLY to be refused'

cases.name: multi-line literal holding ; and --
E-string with backslash-escaped quote and a ;
dollar body with ; and a line comment, tagged and bare
expect:
create function f() returns int language plpgsql as $fn$
begin -- a; b
  return 1;
end $fn$

cases.name: positional parameter and identifier dollar are not quotes
cases.sql:
prepare p as select $1 + a$b from t;
select 5;
expect: prepare p as select $1 + a$b from t

cases.name: comments: line, block, nested block, comment-only statement dropped
